Subject: Lumos AI — request for exceptional Hosted API concession (30%)

Hi team,

Quick escalation — Lumos AI (Sarah Kline, procurement) is asking for a one-time up-front concession of 30% on Hosted API list rates for their first 12 months. Key bullets: 
- Committed ARR (year 1): $1.12M based on forecasted consumption (see attached forecast).
- They want the discount applied to token pricing for text generation and embeddings only (no discounts on add-ons).
- Term: 12 months initially, then automatic renewal at standard pricing unless we renegotiate.
- They are an EU-based analytics vendor with a strong channel presence in healthcare (strategic for us).

Why I'm escalating: this is above the 20% guideline and would materially change unit economics. They are pushing for a decision this week to finalize procurement. I want an exec exemption if you think the strategic upside and ARR justify it.

Ask: Exec approval for up to 30% discount with the following controls if approved:
- Minimum monthly committed spend of $70k for the first 12 months (to protect revenue).
- Audit clause + usage verification rights (no retrospective credits).
- Limit to Hosted API only; Private/Dedicated excluded.
- Review at month 9 for renewal terms.

I've attached the TCV/usage forecast and a proposed term sheet (Redwood_HostedAPI_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf).

Thanks,
Olga

Vivek / Olga,

I ran the numbers on the forecast attached. Short summary (all figures rounded):
- Forecasted tokens (yr1): 4.2B generation tokens + 0.9B embedding tokens.
- Baseline revenue @ list: ~$1.6M year 1.
- Revenue @ 30% concession: ~$1.12M (matches Olga's ARR ask).
- Estimated incremental cost to us (compute + egress + infra amortization): ~$420k.
- Blended gross margin at list = ~74%; at 30% concession = ~62% (a ~12 point delta).

Risks & controls I recommend:
- Require a $70k minimum monthly commitment for months 1–12 (non-refundable credit structure).
- Insert a cap for uncontrolled burst (max QPS/TPS threshold; any usage beyond requires pre-approval).
- Limit discount to LLM text+embedding endpoints only; exclude evaluation/sandbox traffic.
- No SLA credits for first 90 days; service credits thereafter tied to standard policy.

Recommendation: Approve up to 27.5% concession with the controls above OR approve 30% only if Lumos agrees to a prepaid 6-month partial commit (50% of minimums) plus the burst cap and an audit right.

I've attached a margin workbook and a redline term sheet with the proposed addenda.

-Marissa
